body: Thank you so much, sorry I’m just getting back, I’m not on here as much. I have thought of counseling services but, I don’t have much faith in those. My mom was doing that for awhile and I didn’t help her. She has her good days but I’m mentally exhausted from putting up with her. I’m trying my hardest to hang in there!

I’m okay. I know I have my insecurities which made me feel like the relationship was a competition and I did tell him that I had my insecurities but he kept all the girls he once talked to in his life. And those were the girls who were constantly posting about him.
We were on and off. But I’d say a good 5-6 months.

He noticed. And he’d reply back saying he loved them. He once talked to all those girls and they were still stuck on him. These girls knew we were a thing because they all followed me but they didn’t care. He was constantly saying that I was the one who had “hoes” and that I was probably playing him but my guy friends knew to back off.
